title: Internal Sales Executive
description:
Internal Sales Executive

Manchester - office based

Full time

Permanent

Looking for a fresh challenge in industrial automation?

At Routeco, our vision is to be Europe's leading industrial automation and controls specialist. We combine seamless customer experience with unmatched technical expertise to create lasting partnerships that make a real difference to businesses and people. This is Routeco Know-How.

As part of the Sonepar Group-the largest B2 B electrical distributor globally-we offer the stability and scale of a global organisation, while staying firmly rooted in the UK market.

We're committed to shaping a forward-thinking future, valuing professionalism, agility and teamwork every step of the way, with customers at the centre of every decision.

If you want to grow with a company that cares about its people and the world around us, discover what makes Routeco stand out and see where your career could take you.

Supporting customers. Solving problems. Growing together.

We put the customer at the heart of everything we do. As part of our Internal Sales team, you'll play a key role in delivering fast, friendly and knowledgeable support - helping customers with enquiries, quotes and orders across phone, email and digital channels.

You'll work closely with External Sales and Technical colleagues, making sure every customer receives a smooth and professional experience.
- Be part of a friendly, supportive team that values collaboration and celebrates shared success.
- Join a business built on Professionalism, Agility, Collaboration and Excellence, where people take pride in doing the right thing.
- Make an impact every day by helping customers keep their operations running smoothly.

What you'll be doing
- Promoting and selling Routeco products and services, using commercial awareness and negotiation skills to achieve sales targets and support GP growth.
- Providing excellent customer service across phone, email and face-to-face interactions, responding to enquiries accurately and resolving issues promptly.
- Building strong, long-term customer relationships by proactively identifying opportunities, understanding customer needs and encouraging repeat business.
- Developing product knowledge to advise customers on suitable solutions, including franchise and non-franchise products, pricing, availability and delivery timelines.
- Working closely with internal and external sales teams to follow up quotations, convert opportunities and support a smooth customer journey.

What do you need to bring to Routeco?
- A strong customer-focused approach, with the confidence to support customers, manage enquiries and build trusted relationships.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively and inspire commitment from colleagues.
- A proactive, results-driven mindset with strong attention to detail, persistence and a methodical way of working.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office and data entry systems, with the ability to handle customer and order information accurately.
- GCSEs or equivalent in Maths and English are required; an ONC-level qualification or previous experience in electrical engineering or electrical distribution would be beneficial.

What Routeco can offer you
- Generous Time Off: Start with 25 days of annual leave, increasing with length of service up to 30 days with the option to flex up/down 5 days.
- Long Service Rewards: Celebrate your milestones with special gifts and up to 5 extra holiday days in your anniversary year.
- Wellness Benefits:Access a health and wellbeing cashback scheme
- Financial Security: life assurance coverage at 2x your salary.
- Free Shares: you will be eligible to receive free shares after completing 3 years of service.
- Pension Plan: Join our Group personal pension plan with a 5% employer contribution.
- Continuous Learning:1 hour of protected development every week to enhance your skills
- Family-Friendly Leave: Enhanced maternity and paternity leave.
- Recognition: Discretionary 'on the spot' and value-based awards for outstanding performance.
- Volunteer Time Off & Workplace giving: Get paid time off for participating in our volunteering programs and contribute to meaningful causes.
- Exclusive Discounts:Access the Associate Discounts Portal for savings.
- Referral Bonuses: Earn financial reward for referring talented individuals.
- Cycle Scheme:Access to salary sacrifice Cycle Scheme.
- Wellbeing Support and Employee Assistance:Access a 24/7 support program through Unum, and Mental Health First Aiders.
- Fitness Benefits: Enjoy gym membership discounts.

Our promise

At Routeco, we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you're interested but don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply-you might still be a great match. Please inform us of any needed adjustments to the recruitment process when applying.
- We use blind CVs.
- We're GEISS accredited.
- We're a registered Member of Inclusive Employers.
- We have internal focus groups on Mental Health, Menopause, D&I and more.
- We're proud to publish our diversity aims and figures so everyone can see our great work!

Are you ready to make a difference?

title: Client Services Director
description:
Client Services Director

Manchester

About the Opportunity

Our client is a growing and ambitious accountancy and business advisory firm that places a strong emphasis on its people, culture, and long-term development. With a collaborative approach and a commitment to delivering exceptional client service, they offer a supportive environment where individuals are encouraged to develop their careers and make a meaningful impact.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a well-established team in Manchester and play a key role in leading client relationships, developing people, and contributing to the continued growth of the business.

The Role

As Client Services Director, you will work closely with senior leadership and the accounts team to deliver high-quality advisory and compliance services across a diverse client portfolio. The role offers a blend of client-facing responsibilities, team leadership, and commercial involvement.

Key responsibilities include:
- Managing a varied portfolio of clients across multiple sectors.
- Building and maintaining strong, long-term client relationships and acting as a trusted advisor.
- Leading and developing a team, ensuring the delivery of high-quality work and exceptional client service.
- Working collaboratively with directors and colleagues across the wider business.
- Developing a deep understanding of clients' businesses to provide proactive advice and support.
- Identifying opportunities to expand existing client relationships and generate new business.
- Leading business development activity, including networking, proposals, presentations, and pitches.
- Overseeing larger and more complex assignments with support from the wider team.
- Driving efficiencies by reviewing processes and implementing improvements.
- Coaching, mentoring, and developing team members and direct reports.

About You

The successful candidate will be a commercially focused practice professional who enjoys building relationships, developing teams, and contributing to business growth.

This opportunity would suit either:

An experienced Senior Client Manager ready to move into a Director-level position.
An existing Director seeking a fresh challenge within a progressive and growing firm.

You will ideally possess:
- ACA or ACCA qualification.
- Previous experience operating at Senior Manager, Director, or equivalent level within accountancy practice.
- Experience working with a broad range of clients, including owner-managed businesses.
- Strong commercial awareness with a proven ability to identify and develop opportunities.
- A proactive approach to business development and client relationship management.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Strong leadership qualities, with experience developing and motivating teams.
- Confidence working within a collaborative, fast-paced environment.
- Experience using practice management and accounts software, with knowledge of CCH considered advantageous.

Benefits

Alongside a competitive salary package, our client offers a comprehensive benefits programme, including:
- Generous annual leave entitlement.
- Additional birthday leave.
- Holiday purchase scheme.
- Flexible and hybrid working arrangements.
- Salary sacrifice car scheme.
- Structured learning and development opportunities.
- Company pension scheme.
- Private medical scheme via salary sacrifice.
- Access to health and wellbeing resources.
- Regular social, wellbeing, and community engagement initiatives.

About Our Client

Our client is a well-established and growing accountancy and business advisory group with a strong presence across the UK and Ireland. They work closely with a broad client base, supporting businesses through a combination of technical expertise, commercial insight, and relationship-led advice.

The firm has experienced significant growth in recent years and continues to invest in both its people and service offering. Their culture is built around collaboration, integrity, ambition, and delivering exceptional outcomes for clients.

They are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive working environment where individuals are empowered to develop their careers, contribute new ideas, and play an active role in the future success of the business.

If you're looking for an opportunity to combine client leadership, people development, and business growth within a forward-thinking practice, we'd be delighted to hear from you.

title: Client Services Director
description:
Client Services Director

Manchester, UK Permanent Hybrid working

The Opportunity

We are partnering with an established professional services firm to appoint an experienced Client Services Director to join its Manchester team.

This is an exciting opportunity for a commercially minded professional who can build trusted client relationships, deliver exceptional service and contribute to the continued growth and success of the business.

The successful candidate will combine strong client management skills with commercial awareness, strategic thinking and the ability to work collaboratively with colleagues across the organisation.

The Role

As Client Services Director, you will play a key role in developing client relationships, identifying opportunities for growth and ensuring clients receive a high-quality, responsive and commercially focused service.

Your responsibilities are expected to include:
- Client relationship management: Develop and maintain trusted relationships with key clients, acting as a senior point of contact and understanding their business needs.
- Business development: Identify opportunities to grow existing client relationships, develop new business and contribute to the organisation's commercial objectives.
- Client service delivery: Ensure clients receive a consistent, high-quality service and that their expectations and priorities are understood.
- Strategic advice: Work with clients and internal specialists to identify challenges, provide appropriate solutions and support their longer-term objectives.
- Internal collaboration: Build effective working relationships across teams to coordinate services and deliver the best outcomes for clients.
- Commercial performance: Support sustainable growth, strengthen client retention and contribute to the ongoing development of the client portfolio.

About you

We are looking for a confident, commercially aware professional who can combine strategic leadership with a hands-on approach to client relationship management.

You are likely to bring:
- Significant experience in a senior client-facing role within accountancy, professional services or a related environment.
- A strong track record of developing and maintaining senior client relationships.
- Commercial acumen and the ability to identify and convert business development opportunities.
- Excellent communication, influencing and relationship-building skills.
- The ability to understand complex client requirements and coordinate appropriate solutions.
- A collaborative approach, sound judgement and a commitment to delivering outstanding client service.

Relevant professional qualifications and experience advising business clients would be advantageous, depending on your background.

The Organisation

You will be joining an established professional services business with a broad client offering and a focus on building long-term relationships. The organisation values collaboration, professional development and delivering meaningful results for its clients.

This is an opportunity to contribute to the continued development of the business while building your own profile in a senior client services position.

Interested?

If you are an experienced client services professional looking for your next leadership opportunity, we would welcome a confidential conversation.

Apply today to find out more about the role and the organisation.
